notes.title: Major Update 1 Out Now!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone,[/h3][p]The time has finally come...
I'm thrilled to announce that [b]Major Update 1 is officially live![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783165/24d6ed08258ee93f6204c256ed679fc863beb82c.png"][/img][/p][h3]Years of hard work[/h3][p]This update represents years of hard work, remastering, refining, and listening to community feedback. A lot of that time was spend on deep systems work that isn't always visible on the surface. Rewriting core gameplay loops, overhauling AI behavior, balancing combat flow, optimizing performance, and adding in the framework that will carry EXOME forward.[/p][p]These were not quick fixes. They required tearing things down, testing, iterating, and building them back up in a way that I can now expand on more easily.[/p][p]Major Update 1 also delivers a long list of improvements, bug fixes, and quality of life changes that I believe make the experience more intense, more immersive, and ultimately more rewarding for both solo and co-op players.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783165/6db02663eb28a404a70e4f7aaea5ad4c83c992fb.png"][/img][/p][h3]Thank you[/h3][p]I want to sincerely thank every single one of you who stuck with me through the long wait and supported the game during its early stages. Your patience, feedback, and encouragement were crucial, and this update would not exist without the community standing behind it.[/p][p][/p][p]Jump in, try it out, and let me know what you think. I can't wait to hear your thoughts on all the changes.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]New Procedural Event System
[/b]One of the major developments has been the implementation of a new procedural event system. This system introduces dynamic and unpredictable outcomes to the platforms, ensuring that no two playthroughs are alike.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Weather System[/b]
From torrential rainstorms and snowstorms to scorching heatwaves, the weather will not only influence the visual aesthetics but also alter gameplay dynamics. For instance, a sudden downpour might decrease visibility and intensify combat, while clear skies could make things more manageable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Difficulty System[/b]
There is a now a difficulty system to cater to a wider audience. Whether you're a seasoned gamer seeking a challenge or a casual player looking for a more relaxed experience. This ensures that everyone can play at their own preferred pace.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Partial Controller Support
[/b]Can be played with a controller but menus aren't supported yet.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Poise System for players and monsters
[/b]Players and monsters now both have a poise. Players will visual stumble, fall or get thrown back if their poise breaks in a short enough time. Monsters can be staggered if their poise breaks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Player Dodging[/b]
Added a dodging mechanic for the player. I've wanted the player to have more options on how to deal with attackers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Player Melee
[/b]Get your steel toes on because you're going to need them with all that worm kicking.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Explosive Weaponry[/b]
Added explosive weapons in order to help the players deal with larger swarms of enemies. Who doesn't love blowing things up?[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Bullet Ballistics[/b]
Added bullet drop and ricochet to all weapons. Some weapons also have tracer rounds. Bullets also have travel time, influenced by the muzzle velocity of the weapon being fired.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Companion: T.E.S.A.[/b]
Added combat assistant to support solo players in their playthroughs. She will draw some of the monsters’ aggro and help deal damage accordingly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Save System
[/b]After every update in the past, players would be required to start a new save game. This new save system will allow save game migrations for future updates so that you don't have to keep starting over with every update.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Long-awaited Boss Fight[/b]
I'm thrilled to share that the long awaited boss fight is finally in the game. I hope you find this fight as fun and challenging as it was to make![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Monsters[/h3][list][*][p]Monsters have poise now and are capable of being staggered if they receive enough poise damage in a short time period[/p][/*][*][p]Monsters will now look at their target[/p][/*][*][p]Monsters have a varied set of abilities that they will use[/p][/*][*][p]Monsters have a incoming damage buffer that will let them update their target to the highest incoming damage source[/p][/*][*][p]Monsters' ragdoll will now freeze in place if it is old enough[/p][/*][*][p]Monsters now have a chance to study their target before trying to attack again[/p][/*][*][p]Event monsters that are unable to be collected will quickly dissolve[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed framerate issues when there are many monsters active[/p][/*][*][p]Wildlife can now lay down to rest[/p][/*][*][p]Wildlife will now react to gunshots they hear or bullets hitting nearby[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where wildlife would spawn en masse in tight spaces on the map[/p][/*][*][p]Added micro-wormholes that monsters jump out of[/p][/*][*][p]There is now a chance of a "wild wormhole event"[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Weapons[/h3][list][*][p]Added Grenade Launcher[/p][/*][*][p]Added Rocket Launcher[/p][/*][*][p]Added Glowstick throwable[/p][/*][*][p]Added Secondary Weapon upgrade[/p][/*][*][p]Players weapon reload animations are smoother[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed weapons being visible while using their scopes[/p][/*][*][p]Scroll wheel now goes to next/previous weapon slot[/p][/*][*][p]UI fixes regarding weapon information presented to player[/p][/*][*][p]Reload cancelling is now much smoother[/p][/*][*][p]Weapons now have their own unique muzzle pistol[/p][/*][*][p]Added T.E.S.A. and her deployment throwable[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed player hand placement on all weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Increased sitting health recovery[/p][/*][*][p]Added notifications when buying weapons and upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Can now rotate character around in lobby[/p][/*][*][p]Player stamina bar will flash if there's not enough stamina to do an action[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced respawn materialization time from 60s to 45s[/p][/*][*][p]Joining players to a boss fight in progress will be put into spectator mode, until the boss fight is over[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Misc.[/h3][list][*][p]Updated to Unreal Engine 5.6[/p][/*][*][p]Added radial menu that is used for various functions the players can do[/p][/*][*][p]Changed currency of CR (Credits) to MTR (Matter)[/p][/*][*][p]Added Tab panel for Map[/p][/*][*][p]Added Tab panel for Logs[/p][/*][*][p]Added Tab panel for Inventory[/p][/*][*][p]Map is now grid cell based and cells are hidden until visited[/p][/*][*][p]Updated various markers on map[/p][/*][*][p]Map icons for platforms now indicate if the platform has been completed or not[/p][/*][*][p]Added sharpness slider in display settings[/p][/*][*][p]Added weather volume slider to audio settings[/p][/*][*][p]Added difficulty setting, can be changed mid-playthrough if desired[/p][/*][*][p]Some upgrades will now require another upgrade to be purchased first[/p][/*][*][p]Kiosks can now scroll if the content is long enough[/p][/*][*][p]Moved gamma, field of vision, and motion blur to display settings[/p][/*][*][p]Added new log entries and updated others[/p][/*][*][p]Updated lobby to be a little more "ethereal"[/p][/*][*][p]Added several new POIs[/p][/*][*][p]Added underwater effects[/p][/*][*][p]Default Global Illumination is now Lumen. There is an option to turn GI off completely or use Screen Space Illumination[/p][/*][*][p]Added NVIDIA Reflex toggle[/p][/*][*][p]Lobby browser details showing correct values for number of players and ping[/p][/*][*][p]And tons of other bug fixes and quality of life improvements...[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Known Issues[/h3][list][*][p]Gamepad vibration feedback is currently missing[/p][/*][*][p]Player indicators on the map can become stuck after a player revives. tags.feature:
New Procedural Event System
One of the major developments has been the implementation of a new procedural event system. This system introduces dynamic and unpredictable outcomes to the platforms, ensuring that no two playthroughs are alike.

New Weather System
From torrential rainstorms and snowstorms to scorching heatwaves, the weather will not only influence the visual aesthetics but also alter gameplay dynamics. For instance, a sudden downpour might decrease visibility and intensify combat, while clear skies could make things more manageable.

New Difficulty System
There is a now a difficulty system to cater to a wider audience. Whether you're a seasoned gamer seeking a challenge or a casual player looking for a more relaxed experience. This ensures that everyone can play at their own preferred pace.

New Partial Controller Support
Can be played with a controller but menus aren't supported yet.

New Poise System for players and monsters
Players and monsters now both have a poise. Players will visual stumble, fall or get thrown back if their poise breaks in a short enough time. Monsters can be staggered if their poise breaks.

New Player Dodging
Added a dodging mechanic for the player. I've wanted the player to have more options on how to deal with attackers.

New Player Melee
Get your steel toes on because you're going to need them with all that worm kicking.

New Explosive Weaponry
Added explosive weapons in order to help the players deal with larger swarms of enemies. Who doesn't love blowing things up?

New Bullet Ballistics
Added bullet drop and ricochet to all weapons. Some weapons also have tracer rounds. Bullets also have travel time, influenced by the muzzle velocity of the weapon being fired.

New Companion: T.E.S.A.
Added combat assistant to support solo players in their playthroughs. She will draw some of the monsters’ aggro and help deal damage accordingly.

New Save System
After every update in the past, players would be required to start a new save game. This new save system will allow save game migrations for future updates so that you don't have to keep starting over with every update.

New Long-awaited Boss Fight
I'm thrilled to share that the long awaited boss fight is finally in the game. I hope you find this fight as fun and challenging as it was to make!

notes.title: Major Update 1 Testing Phase Begins
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone,[/h3][p]The preview is available to play right... now. ːsteamhappyː[/p][p][/p][h3]What's in this update?[/h3][p]Just to reiterate a little, many of EXOME’s systems have undergone full reworks to support my long-term plans for EXOME’s future. In the initial build, many of these implementations were glorified prototypes. I didn’t put much effort into them at the time because I wasn’t sure if EXOME would find an audience. But it looks like it has and this means that many systems and mechanics needed to be reworked to be more modular. This will reduce the time required for future content and potentially allow for more frequent updates.[/p][p][/p][p]The main goal of this update is to implement the boss fight and properly conclude this area. With modular systems now in place, Update 2 and future updates won’t take as long to develop. By taking the time to restructure things now, subsequent updates should be able to be released much faster.[/p][p][/p][p]This update has been a monumental task for me. Going forward, I’ll be switching to smaller, more manageable updates - not only for my own sake, but also to help everyone stay better caught up on things as EXOME develops.[/p][p][/p][h3]What's next?[/h3][p]During this testing phase I'll be getting things ready for the full release and updating the preview branch as things get fixed. The full release will happen after I'm satisfied that most the problems are fixed. I'm not sure how long this is going to take, but I don't suspect it will take super long.[/p][p][/p][p]As you play the preview, keep in mind that there is a higher potential for encountering bugs that haven't been seen yet. tags.feature:
[b]New Procedural Event System[/b]
One of the major developments has been the implementation of a new procedural event system. This system introduces dynamic and unpredictable outcomes to the platforms, ensuring that no two playthroughs are alike.

[b]New Weather System[/b]
From torrential rainstorms and snowstorms to scorching heatwaves, the weather will not only influence the visual aesthetics but also alter gameplay dynamics. For instance, a sudden downpour might decrease visibility and intensify combat, while clear skies could make things more manageable.

[b]New Difficulty System[/b]
There is a now a difficulty system to cater to a wider audience. Whether you're a seasoned gamer seeking a challenge or a casual player looking for a more relaxed experience. This ensures that everyone can play at their own preferred pace.

[b]New Partial Controller Support
[/b]Can be played with a controller but menus aren't supported yet.

[b]New Poise System for players and monsters
[/b]Players and monsters now both have a poise. Players will visual stumble, fall or get thrown back if their poise breaks in a short enough time. Monsters can be staggered if their poise breaks.

[b]New Player Dodging[/b]
Added a dodging mechanic for the player. I've wanted the player to have more options on how to deal with attackers.

[b]New Player Melee
[/b]Get your steel toes on because you're going to need them with all that worm kicking.

[b]New Explosive Weaponry[/b]
Added explosive weapons in order to help the players deal with larger swarms of enemies. Who doesn't love blowing things up?

[b]New Bullet Ballistics[/b]
Added bullet drop and ricochet to all weapons. Some weapons also have tracer rounds. Bullets also have travel time, influenced by the muzzle velocity of the weapon being fired.

[b]New Companion: T.E.S.A.[/b]
Added combat assistant to support solo players in their playthroughs. She will draw some of the monsters’ aggro and help deal damage accordingly.

[b]New Save System
[/b]After every update in the past, players would be required to start a new save game. This new save system will allow save game migrations for future updates so that you don't have to keep starting over with every update.

[b]New Long-awaited Boss Fight[/b]
I'm thrilled to share that the long awaited boss fight is finally in the game. I hope you find this fight as fun and challenging as it was to make!

I want to introduce you to someone who will hopefully become a pivotal component in everyone's playthroughs, especially for the lone gunners. Now, you won't be so... lone. 😄

T.E.S.A. (Threat Evaluation and Security Android) - a fully functional combat assistant, designed to seamlessly integrate with your playstyle and support you throughout your journey. notes.title: EXOME Development Status: Rematerializer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783165/59ca2c68c40c0b2078e7d3be9b609cb01ddf6342.gif[/img]

Hi everyone!

Work on this update has been going very well! Everything is coming together nicely. I needed to build a new materialization system to support something that I have yet to announce (probably the second coolest thing that will be in this update).

I've heard everyone's feedback about it taking too long to respawn, so I'm reducing the duration of the rematerialization by 10-15 seconds. I still need to do some playtesting with this to get a feel for the right balance.

I'm also adding a boosting feature that will allow you to hold [Interact] and speed up the process. There is a catch, however. The boosting will cost you MTR per second. (I'm also changing CR, which stood for credits, to MTR, which stands for matter - it does the same thing, just a different name.)

The cost of the boost will be dependent on your progress, to balance it with late-game content.

I'm always excited to share new stuff with you guys. Feel free to [url=https://discord.gg/eUVQDBVNVE]join the EXOME Discord[/url] to let me know what you think or if you have any questions about EXOME.

Watch for news on the release date announcement. I'll let you guys know as soon as I can.

Happy Materializing!

notes.title: EXOME Development Status: Ballistic System
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783165/d2357b6cfb669a8e00c50523ca3e977a4fd6de14.gif[/img]

Hey everyone!

I just wanted to show off the new ballistic system.

There are several things happening in this GIF. First, the most obvious is the tracer round (with a slight spin). The sniper rifle currently in the game will be getting tracer rounds in this update. Secondly, notice the bullet drop and the aim elevation used to compensate for it. Lastly, there's an upward ricochet occurring immediately after the hit.

I think these features together will increase the "cool factor" of the weapons quite a bit. I already know they make headshots really satisfying, if I do say so myself.

This system will also open the door to more conventional and futuristic weaponry in future updates.

Most of the work I've been doing recently has been focused on setting up framework systems for future content. Unfortunately, I still can't give a solid release date for the update. That being said, I'm doing my best to make sure future updates are as content-filled as possible. Thank you all for your patience. I look forward to the future of EXOME, and I hope you do too.

[/list]
As a solo developer, progress can be slow, but I'm dedicated to crafting an experience that I'm proud to share with you. It can be challenging at times, but I'm continually learning to make this game the best it can be. I understand the importance of communication, and I'll do my best to provide more frequent updates going forward. Your input is vital, and I'm eager to hear your thoughts and ideas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783165/5c0a96f0d2b52ca88f7ce5bdc470fada3e46c5d2.gif[/img]

Thank you for being a part of this journey with me. I can't wait to share this update with you when it's ready. I'm very grateful for all of your support.

RudeFrog Studios

notes.title: EXOME Update Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I am thrilled to announce the latest update for EXOME. This update brings a host of new features and improvements.

This update introduces the Fragmentation Grenades which will help you turn the tide. I've also added four additional player upgrades that will help you deal with the onslaught.

I've also addressed some of the bugs and glitches that were reported by players to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.

I hope you enjoy this update to EXOME and I look forward to your continued support. As a solo developer, your feedback is incredibly important. I welcome your comments and suggestions as I continue to improve and add content to the game. Feel free to let me know what you think through the in-game feedback panel or the EXOME Discord Server ([url=https://discord.gg/eUVQDBVNVE]https://discord.gg/eUVQDBVNVE[/url]).

Happy gaming!

RudeFrog Studios

notes.title: EXOME is now available!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ddclhIehMIg;full][/previewyoutube]
We sent a research team to analyze and recover several unknown objects that were detected in the area by a newly launched satellite.

The problem is, the research team stopped responding on radio about 48 hours ago. We have no clue why or what exactly is going on in this local area of forest. All we know is we have people on the ground in a potential hostile environment.

Get your squad together! We need you go in and make sure everyone is ok.

Take all the gear with you that you'll need for this job. We will supply you with more weapons and upgrades as you need them. Make sure to conserve your ammunition because it's not like it gets delivered to you either.

- MUSASHI-TENZEN Corp
